setup.choose-goal.title: Choose your connection
setup.choose-goal.explain: Claude + Codex is recommended: HTTPS and OAuth, with Claude Code cloud session notifications. ChatGPT Chat + Codex uses OpenAI Secure Tunnel and requires OpenAI Platform organization permissions and ChatGPT developer mode.
setup.codex-ready.title: Sign in to Codex
setup.codex-ready.explain: Install and sign in to Codex Desktop. On Linux, install Codex CLI and run codex login in your terminal.
setup.claude-code-ready.title: Prepare Claude Code
setup.claude-code-ready.explain: Claude Code CLI must be installed and signed in to send cloud session notifications. Sign in through Claude Code, or choose to skip; notification delivery will then be excluded from acceptance.
setup.claude-code-ready.done: Claude Code CLI authenticated, or skip chosen
setup.permissions.title: Grant local permissions
setup.permissions.explain: Open Permissions & readiness in ARC Settings and grant accessibility, screen recording, full disk access and notifications. You may also choose to skip.
setup.permissions.done: Required permissions granted (or not applicable), or skip chosen
setup.choose-address.title: Choose a connection address
setup.choose-address.explain: Claude needs a public address to reach this computer. A temporary address needs no configuration but changes when ARC restarts, requiring you to add the connector again. A fixed address remains usable and needs a provider account.
setup.address-secret.title: Enter fixed-address credentials
setup.address-secret.explain: Open this connection’s edit form in ARC, select the provider and enter the fixed MCP URL and credential. Paste secrets only into ARC, never into chat.
setup.address-secret.done: Provider credential saved for this ingress
setup.create-ingress.title: Start and check the connection
setup.create-ingress.explain: Reuse the existing ingress and start it. The Claude path also probes the public MCP endpoint and OAuth metadata. If it fails, inspect onboarding findings and retry this step.
setup.create-ingress.done: Ingress running; probe passed for the Claude path
setup.add-connector.title: Add the connector in Claude
setup.add-connector.explain: Add onboarding.url on Claude’s connectors settings page and connect. The user performs login and authorization.
setup.add-connector.done: This ingress received an OAuth registration or authorization request
setup.consent.title: Approve the connection
setup.consent.explain: Review the authorization request in ARC and let the user approve it, then finish OAuth in the browser.
setup.consent.done: An active OAuth grant exists for this ingress
setup.verify-connector.title: Verify the remote connection
setup.verify-connector.explain: Run onboarding.verificationPrompt in the selected remote chat; verify the connection without creating a task.
setup.verify-connector.done: challengeVerifiedAt is later than this setup’s start
setup.loop-test.title: Verify the first loop
setup.loop-test.explain: Create a harmless Codex task through this connector that only replies ARC_ONBOARDING_OK. For Claude, include notifyClaudeSession and wait for the completion notification to be delivered. If Claude Code was skipped, only the task reply is checked.
setup.loop-test.done: A task from this setup completed with the required reply or delivered Claude completion notification
setup.chatgpt-prereq.title: Confirm ChatGPT access
setup.chatgpt-prereq.explain: This path requires OpenAI Platform organization permissions to create a Secure Tunnel and ChatGPT developer mode. Choose Claude if you do not have this access.
setup.chatgpt-prereq.done: User confirmed access, or switched to Claude
setup.tunnel-credentials.title: Create and configure a Secure Tunnel
setup.tunnel-credentials.explain: Create a Tunnel in OpenAI Platform. The agent may read and apply the non-secret tunnelId; only the user pastes the runtime key into ARC’s connection form.
setup.tunnel-credentials.done: This ingress has a tunnelId and saved runtime key
setup.enable-in-chatgpt.title: Enable the connection in ChatGPT
setup.enable-in-chatgpt.explain: Enable this Tunnel in ChatGPT developer mode, open a chat and connect. Leave login and authorization to the user.
setup.enable-in-chatgpt.done: This ingress received an MCP request
setup.option.fixed: Use a fixed address (provider account required)
setup.notification-skipped: Claude Code skipped: loop notifications are unavailable; only task completion and reply are verified.
setup.notification-failed: The task completed, but its Claude notification was not delivered. Check Claude Code login and the target cloud session.
